demo.heading: Try the app without signing up
demo.intro: A household budget planner — an engineering thesis project (React, Spring Boot, microservices, PostgreSQL with sharding and replication). Every account has expenses and budgets from recent months.
demo.notice: The data is shared by all visitors and returns to its initial state every 2 hours. Changing the password and deleting demo accounts is blocked — create your own account to try those features.
